desc: Analyze the operation: it swaps gaps d_i and d_{i+2}, preserving the multiset of even-indexed and odd-indexed gaps separately.
Determine that to minimize the weighted sum (weights decreasing left to right), we should place the smallest gaps at the largest weights, i.e., sort even gaps ascending and odd gaps ascending.
Write Python code to read N and X, compute gaps, separate by parity, sort ascending, reconstruct X from X[0], sum, and print.
Test the code with sample inputs.
